title: feat(app-shell,console): dashboards and the Approvals Inbox draw the console page header; no crumb on a dashboard or page route (objectui#12526)
body:
Fixes #12526
Clause-②: yes — `@object-ui/app-shell` exports one component, `ConsolePageHeader` (the console page header), and its props type `ConsolePageHeaderProps`. Nothing else on the public surface changes: no prop, option, pack key or schema read.

## What changes

- **Dashboards.** `DashboardView` renders the console `PageHeader` instead of its own `h1` and description line: the dashboard icon in the chip, the dashboard's label as the title, its description beside the title from `sm` up, in one row. The title and description reads are the same expressions as before (`resolveKeyedI18nLabel(dashboard.label, t) || dashboard.name`; the description from `previewSchema ?? dashboard`; drawn as served). Only the element that draws them changed.
- **Approvals Inbox** (`apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`). Its `h1`, subtitle line and Refresh button become `ConsolePageHeader` with `title`, `subtitle`, `icon` and its Refresh in `actions`, spanning the page above the padded body. The i18n calls are the existing `approvalsInbox.title` / `.subtitle` / `.refresh`; no key is added.
- **App bar.** On `/apps/APP/dashboard/NAME` and `/apps/APP/page/NAME`, `AppHeader` draws nothing after the app pill and its PREVIEW chip, as objectui#12461 did for object routes. The dashboard and page branches no longer push into `extraSegments`; they set the phone title the way the object branch does (the variable is renamed `routeTitle`, since it now serves three route kinds). The phone bar's compact title below `sm` reads the same labels as before. Report routes, `system/*` routes, component routes and the `home` / `orgs` / `studio` variants are unchanged.
- **Export.** `src/layout/index.ts` re-exports `PageHeader as ConsolePageHeader`, and `src/index.ts` publishes it with `ConsolePageHeaderProps`. `PageHeader` itself is still not exported from the root, so it cannot collide with `@object-ui/layout`'s `PageHeader`. The `PageHeader.tsx` docblock no longer says the component is unreachable outside the package; the rename history stays.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **A1 (page routes name themselves): holds for every page route a navigation entry opens.** Read on HotCRM `main` `63db83e` and objectstack `main` `c9810dd9d` examples. HotCRM opens two pages by route: `sales_home_page` (`type: 'home'`, a titled `page:header`) and `account_workbench` (`type: 'list'` with `interfaceConfig.source`). The showcase opens 25 (`home`, `app` and `list` kinds, interface pages included). `app-crm`'s one page, `crm_welcome`, is `home` with a `page:header`. The renderer side: `PageRenderer` draws the page `label` as an `h1` for every kind except `record` unless a titled `page:header` owns it, and `InterfaceListPage` draws the label as an `h1` above its list. So each of these pages shows a name from `sm` up without the crumb. The bound is in the Acceptance notes: a `record` page opened on a page route has no name of its own, and no navigation entry in either corpus does that.
- **A2 (Refresh All): stays in the renderer.** `DashboardView` mounts `DashboardRenderer` (not `DashboardGridLayout`). The renderer draws its refresh control whenever it holds `onRefresh`, and the same handler arms the authored `refreshIntervalSeconds` timer (`useDashboardAutoRefresh`). `hideHeaderText`, already passed, hides the renderer's title and description only. No existing prop hides the refresh control while keeping the timer, so moving the button needs a new `plugin-dashboard` prop. Per the dispatch, it is left where it is and reported. The label appears once on the page: it did before (the view drew it, `hideHeaderText` kept the renderer from drawing it) and does now, pinned with the real renderer and a declared `header`.
- **A3 (`header.showTitle` / `showDescription`): not honored by `DashboardView` before, not honored now.** The view drew the label and description unconditionally; the toggles only reach the renderer's own header, which `hideHeaderText` suppresses. No new behavior on either key. A comment at the header says so.
- **A4 (phone width): both keep a header below `sm`, and the header's own rules change what it shows there.** Before: the dashboard drew a stacked block (title, then the description on a second line); the inbox drew a stacked block (a large icon and title, the subtitle, then Refresh on its own row). Neither hid its header below `sm`, unlike `ObjectView`. After: one row with the icon chip, the title, and the inbox's Refresh. The console `PageHeader` hides its secondary line below `sm` (objectui#12423), so the dashboard's description and the inbox's subtitle are no longer drawn on a phone. The title is `text-base` semibold, where it was `text-lg` bold (dashboard) and `text-2xl` semibold (inbox). On the inbox's component route the phone bar names the app, not the page, so the header stays the page's only name there.

## Dashboard icon

`DashboardSchema` declares no `icon`, so a dashboard document carries none. The chip draws `LayoutDashboard`, the glyph the console writes on a dashboard's navigation entry (`newDashboardNavigationItem`) and draws for the dashboard kind on Home, search, Studio and the command palette. The sidebar draws a navigation entry's authored `icon`, with `FileText` when there is none; it has no dashboard-kind default of its own.

## File surface

As claimed, plus one file: `packages/app-shell/README.md` gains a `ConsolePageHeader` section and one sentence under `DashboardView`. AGENTS.md rule #2 asks for README docs with a new export. Its `tsx` snippet compiles strict against the built `dist` (exit 0). The tests beside each file: four new pins, four updated AppHeader pins whose dashboard or page cells drew a crumb (`AppHeader.dashboardReportCrumb-12273`, `AppHeader.pageRouteNoAuthoringHandles-12198`, `AppHeader.appIdentity-12201`, and the comments of `AppHeader.servedLabels-11295`), and the docblock of `PageHeader.subtitle`.

## Tests (at `34a0f5a47b`, the final commit)

- New pins: `AppHeader.dashboardPageNoCrumb-12526` (dashboard and page routes: nothing after the chip from `sm` up, no desktop element reads the label, the phone title names it by the served label or the humanized slug; CONTROLS: report crumb, `system/*` crumbs, the component route), `DashboardView.pageHeader-12526` (real renderer: `page-header` holds the label `h1`, the description beside it and an icon; one `h1`; the label and description once each; one Refresh All; no description means no secondary line), `ConsolePageHeader.rootExport-12526` (the root's `ConsolePageHeader` is the package's `PageHeader`; no root `PageHeader`; `ConsolePageHeaderProps` takes `subtitle` and refuses `description` at compile time), `ApprovalsInboxPage.pageHeader-12526` (one `h1` in `page-header`, the subtitle in its row, an icon, Refresh reloads; the header sits above the padded body).
- Every suite naming `AppHeader`, `DashboardView`, `PageHeader` or `ApprovalsInboxPage` (131 files), from the repo root under the lock: `Test Files  131 passed (131)`, `Tests  1761 passed (1761)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Census and ratchet sweep, `git grep -l -E 'census|ratchet|exports.*snapshot|api-surface' -- '**/*.test.ts*'` (501 test files): `Test Files  501 passed (501)`, `Tests  14466 passed | 8 skipped (14474)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. No snapshot or export census needed an entry for the new export.
- Ablations, under the lock, through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode inside a script with a restore trap. No dist leg: each suite imports the subject from source (relative imports; `@object-ui/app-shell` aliases to `src`).
  - A, the dashboard crumb put back (`routeTitle =` turned back into an `extraSegments.push`): anchor 1 to 0, blob `a9f24b57` to `ba8dd631`; `Tests  6 failed | 13 passed (19)`. The four dashboard cells and the two `12273` dashboard cells went red; the page, report, `system/*` and component cells stayed green.
  - B, the `DashboardView` `h1` block put back in place of `PageHeader`: anchor 1 to 0; `Tests  4 failed (4)`.
  - C, the inbox's old `header` block put back: anchor 1 to 0; `Tests  3 failed (3)`.
  - Every restore: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Control on the restored tree: `Tests  26 passed (26)`.
- Reverse check of the published type: a console file passing `description` to `ConsolePageHeader`, compiled against the rebuilt `dist`, fails with TS2322 (`Property 'description' does not exist on type 'IntrinsicAttributes & ConsolePageHeaderProps'`).

## Gates (local)

- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2` under the lock: `Tasks: 34 successful, 34 total`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0 (`tsconfig.test.json` lists all eight touched app-shell suites). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0 (lists the page and its new suite).
- eslint on the changed files, as each package's `lint` script runs it: 0 errors in both packages (warnings only, all on lines this diff does not add).
- `check:control-bytes` 0 · `check:new-line-citations` 0 (`0 new citation(s)`) · `check:i18n-keys` 0 · `check:vi-mock-specifiers` 0 · `check:vi-mock-override-shape` 0 · `check:vi-mock-inherit` 0 · `check:test-path-roots` 0 · `check:spec-symbols` 0 · `check:side-effects-array` 0 · `check:unreferenced-sources` 0 · `check:self-import` 0 · `check:phantom-deps` 0 · `check:esm-specifiers` 0 · `check-doc-links` 0 · `check-doc-fence-languages` 0.
- Changeset gates: `check-changeset-no-major` 0, `check-changeset-overwrite` 0 (1 added, 0 modified), `check-changeset-fixed` 0, `check-changeset-presence` 0 (2 released packages, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-claims` 0 (report-only; it names `11806-login-server-unreachable.md` for the README, whose paragraph about the sign-up table is still true).
- `check:readme-exports`: the new binding reads `real  packages/app-shell/README.md  ConsolePageHeader`; the run exits 2 locally because `@object-ui/cli` and `@object-ui/plugin-ai` are not built in this tree (outside the console closure). NOT MEASURED as a whole here; CI builds them.
- NOT MEASURED locally, declared to CI: `check:doc-snippets` (its build closure includes packages outside the console closure; the one new snippet compiled on its own, above), `check:eager-closure` (needs a console `vite build`), and the full lint and test farm.

## Acceptance notes

- **A record page on a page route.** A `type: 'record'` page delegates its heading to a `page:header`, and on a page route a `{token}` title has no record to fill it, so such a page opened by URL on `/page/NAME` has no name from `sm` up now that the crumb is gone. No navigation entry in HotCRM or the objectstack examples opens a record page on a page route; record pages reach users through record routes. Not filed: no producer.
- **`header.showTitle` / `showDescription` on the console page** (A3). The spec describes them as toggling the dashboard title and description; the console page draws both whatever they say, as before. No dashboard in HotCRM or the objectstack examples authors either key as `false`. Not filed: no producer.
- **The inbox's `system/approvals` route** keeps its `System` and `Approvals` crumbs from `sm` up (the dispatch fences `system/*` crumbs out), so there the page is named in the bar and in its header. Its component route draws no crumb, as before.
- **Pending changesets in the same release.** The objectui#12198, objectui#12273 and objectui#12461 entries describe dashboard and page trails this change removes. They are not edited (that is the overwrite gate's territory); this change's entry says it supersedes them for those two routes.
- **Refresh All in the page header** needs a new `plugin-dashboard` prop (A2); left for the seat.
- **Other console pages** with a hand-drawn `h1` header are listed in the report for one family card.
